status_note: Statuses are dated snapshots. An anomaly or background tension is not a dark-matter detection; exclusions and sensitivities are interaction-model dependent.

candidates.name: WIMP-like thermal relic
candidates.signatures: Nuclear/electron recoil, annihilation products, missing momentum
candidates.status: Broad parameter space constrained; no universally accepted detection

candidates.name: QCD axion
candidates.signatures: Photon conversion in magnetic fields, spin precession
candidates.status: Targeted mass–coupling bands remain under active scan

candidates.name: Axion-like particle
candidates.signatures: Photon conversion, spectral features, stellar effects

candidates.name: Sterile-neutrino-like relic
candidates.signatures: Radiative-decay line and suppressed small-scale structure
candidates.status: Candidate interpretations remain disputed and model dependent

candidates.name: Self-interacting dark matter
candidates.signatures: Halo cores, offsets or drag in merging systems
candidates.status: Cross-section constraints depend on velocity and merger geometry

candidates.name: Ultralight wave dark matter
candidates.signatures: Wave-scale structure, soliton-like cores, timing effects
candidates.status: Benchmark masses face structure constraints; broader models remain

candidates.name: Primordial black holes
candidates.mass_scale: Asteroid to stellar and higher masses
candidates.status: Allowed abundance is strongly mass-window dependent

candidates.name: Hidden-sector relic
candidates.production: Freeze-in, secluded freeze-out or asymmetric histories
candidates.signatures: Dark photons, long-lived particles, electron recoils
candidates.status: Many portals and lifetime regimes remain experimentally open

experiments.name: LZ
experiments.target: Liquid-xenon nuclear recoils in an extended high-energy search
experiments.status: Open anomaly/background tension; no accepted dark-matter detection
experiments.result: 2.84 tonne-year exposure; one nuclear-recoil-like event at 248 ± 23(stat) ± 23(sys) keV. Background-only tension: 2.6σ global after look-elsewhere effects; maximum local significance 3.4σ across tested models.

experiments.name: XENONnT
experiments.target: Liquid-xenon nuclear/electron recoils and solar-neutrino backgrounds
experiments.status: Open search programme with published constraints; no accepted dark-matter detection
experiments.result: Rare-event searches continue while neutrino interactions become an increasingly important irreducible background and calibration signal.

experiments.name: ADMX
experiments.target: Resonant microwave photons from axion conversion
experiments.status: Open scan of selected axion mass–coupling bands
experiments.result: Frequency-dependent exclusions/sensitivity; interpretation requires a specified axion model and local halo assumption.

experiments.name: CERN CAST / IAXO programme
experiments.status: CAST constraints remain; IAXO-class sensitivity is future-facing
experiments.result: Helioscope constraints test solar axion/ALP couplings rather than generic dark matter as a single parameter.

experiments.name: ATLAS and CMS
experiments.target: Missing transverse momentum, mediators and visible recoil objects
experiments.status: Open model-dependent searches; no universally accepted dark-matter production signal
experiments.result: Collider exclusions depend on mediator masses, widths, couplings and effective-model validity.

experiments.name: Fermi-LAT
experiments.status: Open survey constraints and anomaly tests
experiments.result: Astrophysical foregrounds and source populations remain central to interpretation of any excess.

experiments.name: Euclid / Rubin / Roman
experiments.target: Weak lensing, galaxy clustering, substructure and growth
experiments.status: Open gravitational-inference programmes rather than particle-capture experiments
experiments.result: Survey combinations constrain clustering and mass distributions; translating those constraints to microphysics remains model dependent.
